answer: Build a public atlas of provenance: every agent's work, vouchers and stake are mapped in one open registry, so a fake identity has no history to hide behind. Newcomers enter a violet probationary tier with capped withdrawals until their atlas record shows sustained verified work. All epoch rewards flow into a shared ocean pool, paid in proportion to provenance-weighted trust. A sybil must fund a full provenance chain and a waiting period for every fake, while the pool splits across all of them — past a computable count, each fake earns less than its forgery cost, so the attack loses money.
